issues.status: demonstrated construction defect with proved local replacement

source_location.claim: Lemma6.3, displayed assembly immediately before(6.13); use after(6.21)

issues.hypotheses: tau=L=1, epsilon=ell=1/10, g(t)=e1/8 for all real t; g is nonzero L2loc, ell>=epsilon and G=ell integral|g|^2=1/640<epsilon L.
issues.suspect_step: Non-cumulative offset c_i=g_{i-1}^epsilon-gbar_{i-1} is used after each local primitive has zero bottom trace.
issues.decisive_evidence: M=4,N=3,q=1; heights(2/5,2/5,1/5), gbar1=gbar2=-e1/2, projections=-e1, offsets(0,-e1/2,-e1/2). At y=4/5 lower trace=-e1 and upper=-e1/2, hence jump=e1/2 notin Z^2. The failure also holds for ell=epsilon<1/8 with the same g,L,tau.
counterevidence_and_alternatives: Reversing orientation only changes the sign of the half-integer.
Local primitives have explicitly zero bottom trace; a global-primitive reading conflicts with source endpoint data.
Changing floor choices by lattice vectors cannot remove the half-integer residue.
A sign change alone fails to carry previous residuals.
This is not a counterexample to the existential lemma or main theorem.

repair.statement: Let c1=0 and c_(i+1)=c_i+gbar_i-P_q(c_i+gbar_i), Atilde_i=A_i+c_i tensor e1. Then jumps=-P_q(c_i+gbar_i) lie in qZ^2 and every residual lies in[0,q)^2.
repair.proof: Report Proposition3.1 proves unchanged second column, bottom/top trace conditions, interior curl, interface support and integral bound <=2(M^2+1/3)G+4tau^2 epsilon^2 L/ell. Core area <=C_lambda epsilon L/M; with M^2G=epsilon L/M the source energy order follows.
repair.verified_scope: Complete local interpolation statement and energy order; not complete downstream theorem reconstruction.

source_location.claim: Section5.2.1 equations(5.15),(5.21),(5.22), specialized by(5.37) and used in(5.49)

issues.hypotheses: ell=h=1,r=rho=1/4,eta=eta_tilde=1,mu=mu_tilde=1/2; rectangular restrictions hold and denominators are nonzero. Circulation in(5.17) is zero, so quantization excludes no example parameter.
issues.suspect_step: Bound depends only on differences and mean compression, omitting common shear.
issues.decisive_evidence: On both positive-area interpolation regions Dhat=[[1,1/2],[0,1]]. Printed RHS=0 but norm(Dhat-I)^2=1/4 and dist(Dhat,SO(2))^2=17/4-sqrt(17)>0; integral bound also fails.
counterevidence_and_alternatives: Actual norm-to-SO(2) computation rules out a norm/orientation explanation.
Squaring only the last compression term would not restore the omitted mean shear.
Under source specialization mu_tilde=-mu and eta+eta_tilde=2cos(alpha), the added mean term is O(alpha^4).

repair.statement: Retain d=(mu_tilde-mu,eta_tilde-eta), a=((mu+mu_tilde)/2,(eta+eta_tilde)/2-1). Bound dist^2 by C|d|^2[h^2/ell^2+h^4/ell^2(1/x2^2+x1^2/x2^4)]+2|a|^2.
repair.proof: Directly expand printed gradient columns and apply |v+w|^2<=2|v|^2+2|w|^2; source specialization and cell counts give added O(L epsilon tau alpha^3), below target Read-Shockley order for small positive alpha.
repair.verified_scope: Pointwise bound and asymptotic contribution of missing mean term.
